message: Heads-up: 84 SP across 12 issues is far above what we've closed in recent sprints, and a third of those ran about 5 days late. Can we trim scope now so we can close on the planned date?

We've committed 34 issues, but recent sprints finished about 4 each and two of the last three closed late by around 5 days. Let's agree today on what we drop if we're behind at mid-sprint, so we still close on time.
41 SP in a 7-day sprint, including a 24-point item, is a lot next to our recent completion rate. Could we split or defer the big improvement now so the sprint can close on its end date?

Two of our last three sprints closed about 5 days late and we finished very little of what we committed. Let's check daily whether these three bugs are moving and close the sprint on the planned date either way.
We've taken on 13 issues, four of them unestimated, and one recent sprint ran 10 days past its end. Let's estimate the open items and set a firm close date now so we don't slip again.
